verdict.rationale: Weave's Python/TS SDK lets code (or an agent) build a Dataset and Evaluation object, run it, and score results (docs-6/25/31), and a REST Service API exposes this programmatically (docs-15). Weave explicitly advertises an MCP server enabling coding agents to 'run evaluations' and 'read live production data' autonomously (docs-20), corroborated by the existence of an official MCP server repo (probe-4).
